reviews.comment: Griffith is a boring lecturer, and the material is already boring to learn. She allows students to have 5 pages of notes for the tests and informs you when there is an in-class activity. I rarely attended class and learned nothing, but still easily got a B. She posts her lecture notes, which allows you to make good notes without attending class.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things
